ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the square $ABCD$, $AB=6$, point $Q$ is a moving point on side $AB$ (point $Q$ does not coincide with point $B$), and points $M$, $N$ are the midpoints of $DQ$ and $BQ$, respectively. What is the length of segment $MN$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, connect BD,\\
$\because$ M and N are the midpoints of BQ and DQ, respectively,\\
$\therefore$ MN is the midline of $\triangle QBD$,\\
$\because$ MN=$\frac{1}{2}$BD,\\
$\because$ Quadrilateral ABCD is a square,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle$A=$90^\circ$, AB=AD=6,\\
$\therefore$ BD=$\sqrt{AB^{2}+AD^{2}}=6\sqrt{2}$,\\
$\therefore$ MN= $\boxed{3\sqrt{2}}$.
